title: Text: DET Dan Griesbaum ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: Were you guys fed any info on the hats?
Just in general. I heard they may have convinced Chris to make a change. Last year’s hat was nowhere to be found on Saturday and the public photo opp areas had the old version in it
I just haven’t been able to find out if they are flat out going back to the old one or if there is a compromise somewhere in between.
I’m trying to find pics of players wearing it
At Tigerfest? From what I could tell, nobody wore one the whole weekend
Last year they wore the new ones the entire caravan
Yeah I wonder if that was just to promote the new hats
